Carmen: Heads-up  Unison Health (acct UH-220) autopay failed twice during today's run. First attempt was a corporate virtual card (ending 5120) declined as unsupported_card_type for recurring. Second attempt with a new card token returned authentication_required (3DS). They asked for wire or same-day ACH to avoid collection hold — CFO wants this cleared today.
Drew: Thanks. Drop invoice numbers + totals and I'll prep the wire template. Also can flip account to manual_collect and apply a 7-day grace flag so we don't auto-suspend.
Carmen: INV-9410 $7,200, INV-9411 $3,300, INV-9412 $1,500 — total $12,000. Billing contact is cfo@unisonhealth.com (Marco). He prefers wire but asked if we can accept a one-time ACH or a virtual-card manual override.
PaymentsBot: [auto] Attempt 2026-03-23T11:05:22Z INV-9410 -> declined:unsupported_card_type (virtual_card recurring blocked). Retry 2026-03-23T11:10:58Z INV-9411 -> authentication_required (3DS).
Ari-ops: We don't accept virtual cards for recurring by default. For a one-off virtual card manual override we'd need risk sign-off and a signed card authorization form + matching invoice ref. That takes ~30-60 min. Wire/ACH is faster for immediate posting.
Drew: Wire block to provide to Marco (copy/paste):
```
Bank: Redwood Clearing Bank
Routing / ABA: 777000888
Account number: 2211334455
Beneficiary name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
SWIFT/BIC: RCBKUS55
Reference: INV-9410 / UnisonHealth
Address: 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103
```
Carmen: I'll offer both options in the message: a one-time ACH link (expires 2h) and the wiring instructions. Also asking them to attach a signed wire authorization + a bank letter or statement for beneficiary verification.
Carmen: Drafting note: "Hi Marco  sorry for the interruption. For fastest processing you can either use this one-time ACH link (expires in 2 hours): https://pay.redwood.com/pay/UH-XXXXXX or wire to the attached details. If wiring, please attach a signed wire authorization and a bank letter/statement that shows the account name and number plus a bank contact for verification. If you prefer to retry the corporate card, please attach a signed card authorization form and indicate it's a one-time charge. Reply here and we'll accelerate posting."
Ari-ops: For ACH micro-deposits: if they want ACH and they are new to ACH we can do micro-deposit verification but that will delay posting 2+ business days. One-time ACH link bypasses micro-deposits and is best for same-day, subject to our ACH cut-off.
PaymentsBot: [auto] Manual collect flag set by Drew at 11:18:07Z. Delinquency hold scheduled 2026-03-30T00:00:00Z if unpaid.
SalesOps-Beth: FYI Sales asked we do not auto-pause product for this account — they have an active renewal conversation and churn risk is high. Please keep grace flags.
Drew: Noted, applied grace_7d and manual_collect. Carmen pls request the signed wire auth + bank doc. Ari, if they ask for virtual-card override, what exact fields do you need on the authorization form?
Ari-ops: We need cardholder name, card last 4, exact amount, invoice refs, merchant descriptor authorization, and a statement that it's a one-time charge. Signed by authorized signatory. Also need a copy of the company PO or email from CFO stating approval. Risk sign-off required.
Carmen: Marco replied via email: "Preparing wire form and bank letter now, will CC treasury contact. If virtual card override is faster, we'll attach card auth and PO."
Ari-ops: If they send card auth + PO, route to me. I'll expedite risk review but will need SalesOps-Beth to co-sign for the override. That typically clears in ~45 mins.
Drew: I'll prepare reconciliation entry code: BANK-WIRE-UNISON and keep invoices pending. Carmen, once docs hit post them here and I'll coordinate posting.
PaymentsBot: [auto] Reminder: if wire posts, finance should reconcile with reference INV-9410/9411/9412 and mark autopay attempts cleared.
Carmen: Sending follow-up to Marco now. Will update thread when attachments arrive. Thanks team. :pray:
